# [[Quests/Suereé Quests/The Missing Pocket Watch\|The Missing Pocket Watch]]

A well-dressed gentleman has lost a silver pocket watch somewhere in the busy streets of [[Locations/Primary Locations/Suerré\|Suerré]]. Believing it to have been stolen, he asks the party to recover it.

What initially appears to be a simple case of theft turns out to be considerably less sinister.

>[!Quote |mark] [[Characters/Suerre Characters/Henri Beaumont\|Henri Beaumont]]
>"It was my father's. I don't care what it's worth. I want it back."

#### Description

The party may encounter [[Characters/Suerre Characters/Henri Beaumont\|Henri Beaumont]] searching frantically through the streets of Suerré.

> **Henri:** "Please! You there! Have you seen a silver pocket watch?"

> - **The Party:** "No. What happened?"
> - **The Party:** "When did you last have it?"
> - **The Party:** **[Moxie]** "You look more frightened than someone who's merely lost a watch." **(DC 10)**

Henri explains that the watch belonged to his father and was passed down to him. He believes someone must have taken it while he was walking through the market.

##### Searching the Market

Henri remembers having the watch while visiting several shops in the market district. The party retraces his steps.

A character with sufficient [**Cut Of Your Jib (CTJ)**](Cut%20Of%20Your%20Jib%20\(CTJ\)) can notice a small disturbance near one of the market stalls.

> **[Cut Of Your Jib]** "Someone bumped into you here. Check the ground." **(DC 10)**

The party finds a small brass chain caught beneath a market stall. It appears to have been torn from the pocket watch.

Alternatively, a character with sufficient [**Certain Je Ne Sais Quoi (JNSQ)**](Certain%20Je%20Ne%20Sais%20Quoi%20\(JNSQ\)) can notice that one of the nearby stallholders is acting nervously.

> **[Certain Je Ne Sais Quoi]** "That merchant keeps looking at us. Ask him about the watch." **(DC 12)**

The merchant admits that he saw Henri drop something while crossing the market.

##### The Suspect

The chain leads the party to a young street thief named [[Characters/Suerre Characters/Lucien Marchand\|Lucien Marchand]], who is sitting in an alley nearby. He has the watch.

> **Lucien:** "It's not stolen."

- **The Party:** "Then why do you have it?"
- **The Party:** "Give it back."
- **The Party:** "We'll be taking that."
- **The Party:** **[Chutzpah]** "You have two choices. Give us the watch, or explain to its owner why you decided to keep it." **(DC 10)**
- **The Party:** **[Moxie]** "You found it, didn't you?" **(DC 10)**

If the Moxie check succeeds, Lucien admits that he found the watch lying in the street. He intended to sell it, but has not yet done so.

If the party simply asks him about the watch, Lucien claims that he found it and does not believe he has done anything wrong.

The party can pay him for it, persuade him to return it, or take it from him.

##### Returning the Watch

The party returns to Henri with the pocket watch. Henri is visibly relieved. He takes the watch and carefully winds it.

> **Henri:** "You found it."
> **Henri:** "My father carried this for thirty years."

The party can ask why he was so certain it had been stolen. Henri admits that he was embarrassed to have simply dropped it.

> **Henri:** "I suppose I was rather dramatic."

> - **The Party:** "A little."
> - **The Party:** "You accused half the market of stealing it."
> - **The Party:** **[Moxie]** "You weren't looking for a thief. You were looking for someone to blame." **(DC 10)**

If the MOX check succeeds, Henri admits that he panicked because of the watch's sentimental value.

##### Outcomes

###### Return the Watch
The party convinces Lucien to return the watch or retrieves it from him. Henri pays the promised reward.

**Reward:** 20 Ere.

###### Pay Lucien

The party can offer Lucien a small amount of money in exchange for the watch. Henri still pays the party their promised reward. Lucien is surprised that anyone would pay him for something he found.

**Reward:** 20 Ere, minus the amount given to Lucien.

###### Keep the Watch

The party can choose not to return the watch. Henri remains convinced that it was stolen and continues searching the market. The quest can be completed without the party returning it, although no reward is received. The party keeps [[Quest Items/Henri's Pocketwatch\|Henri's Pocketwatch]].

###### Convince Lucien to Return It

A successful **Moxie** or **Persuasion** check can convince Lucien that keeping the watch is not worth the trouble.

> **[Moxie]** "You found something that mattered to someone. You can either make his day or make his life worse." **(DC 10)**

Lucien reluctantly hands over the watch.

> **Lucien:** "Fine. But if he asks, you found it."

#### Map

#### Rewards

20 Ere and 2 [[Reputation/Suerré Reputation\|Suerré Reputation]] _or_
20 Ere less the payoff to [[Characters/Suerre Characters/Lucien Marchand\|Lucien Marchand]] and 2 [[Reputation/Suerré Reputation\|Suerré Reputation]] _or_
[[Quest Items/Henri's Pocketwatch\|Henri's Pocketwatch]] and -1 [[Reputation/Suerré Reputation\|Suerré Reputation]]

#### Progress

>[!Quote |mark] [[Characters/Suerre Characters/Henri Beaumont\|Henri Beaumont]]
> "Please, you must find it. It belonged to my father. I don't care what it's worth, I simply want it back."

#### Completion

>[!Quote |mark] [[Characters/Suerre Characters/Henri Beaumont\|Henri Beaumont]]
>"You found it. I cannot thank you enough. My father carried this watch for thirty years. I feared I'd lost a piece of him with it."

>[!Quote |mark] [[Characters/Suerre Characters/Lucien Marchand\|Lucien Marchand]]
>"Fine, fine. Take the thing. Though I still say I was doing him a favour by finding it."
